name: Kartu Keluarga
llm_field_rules: nomor_kk: 16-digit numeric ID (Nomor Kartu Keluarga). NEVER a person name.
nama_kepala_keluarga: Person name in ALL CAPS from the 'Kepala Keluarga' field.
alamat: Full street address string.
rt_rw: Two 3-digit numbers separated by a slash (e.g. 003/005). If OCR merged them, add the slash.
desa_kelurahan: Village or kelurahan name.
kecamatan: District (kecamatan) name.
kabupaten_kota: City or regency name (e.g. Jakarta Timur, Kabupaten Bogor).
kode_pos: 5-digit postal code NUMBER ONLY. NEVER a province or city name. Set null if no 5-digit number is found.
provinsi: Province name (e.g. DKI Jakarta, Jawa Barat, Jawa Tengah). NEVER a postal code.

Extract ALL family members listed in the table into the 'anggota_keluarga' array. Group the details of the same person together into a single object. The OCR text may have column data mixed up, so infer the rows logically.

For each family member, extract: nama_lengkap, nik, jenis_kelamin, tempat_lahir, tanggal_lahir, agama, pendidikan, jenis_pekerjaan, status_perkawinan, status_hubungan, kewarganegaraan, nama_ayah, nama_ibu.
nik: 16-digit numeric ID for each family member. NEVER a person name.
jenis_kelamin: LAKI-LAKI or PEREMPUAN.
tempat_lahir: City/regency name ONLY. Remove any trailing garbage characters like +, .<, !, ,、, or other OCR artifacts.
tanggal_lahir: Date in DD-MM-YYYY format.
agama: Religion name (e.g. ISLAM, KRISTEN, KATOLIK, HINDU, BUDDHA, KONGHUCU).
pendidikan: Education level (e.g. SD, SMP, SMA, D3, S1, S2, S3).
jenis_pekerjaan: Occupation (e.g. KARYAWAN SWASTA, PEGAWAI NEGERI, RUMAH TANGGA, PELAJAR/MAHASISWA).
status_perkawinan: Marital status (e.g. KAWIN, BELUM KAWIN, CERAI HIDUP, CERAI MATI).
status_hubungan: Family relation (e.g. KEPALA KELUARGA, ISTRI, ANAK).
kewarganegaraan: Must be WNI or a country name. NEVER a religion like ISLAM or KRISTEN.
nama_ayah: Father's name in ALL CAPS.
nama_ibu: Mother's name in ALL CAPS.
CRITICAL: Preserve spaces between words in Names and Addresses (e.g. 'MIRA SETIAWAN' not 'MIRASETIAWAN').
Use null if a field is empty or marked with a dash (-).
